title: GREAT-ESDD: Graph Edge Attention Network for Effectively Steered Delivery Decisions
abstract: arXiv:2610.14792v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Online, same-day delivery requires operators to constantly update their routes, and the routing cost for deliveries increases with the number of customers. Out-of-home (OOH) delivery options can help companies handle increasing customer numbers while keeping delivery costs low. We develop a dynamic pricing-and-routing framework for this online ordering scenario with home and OOH delivery options. First, we develop a neural solver for the capacitated vehicle routing problem (CVRP) based on the Graph-Edge-Attention-Network (GREAT). We train it to solve CVRP with varying instance sizes and starting conditions, allowing it to reoptimize partially executed routes under changing conditions. It is fast while achieving solution quality competitive with traditional baselines. translated_title: GREAT-ESDD：用于有效引导配送决策的图边注意力网络
translated_abstract: 在线当日达配送要求运营者不断更新配送路线，且配送的路径成本会随客户数量的增加而上升。户外自提（OOH）配送选项可以帮助公司在保持较低配送成本的同时应对不断增长的客户数量。我们针对这种同时提供送货上门与户外自提配送选项的在线订购场景，开发了一个动态定价与路径规划框架。首先，我们基于图边注意力网络开发了一个用于求解带容量约束车辆路径问题（CVRP）的神经求解器。我们通过训练使其能够求解不同规模和不同起始条件的CVRP实例，从而在条件发生变化时对部分已执行的路线进行重新优化。该求解器速度快，同时其求解质量与传统基线方法相比具有竞争力。我们的求解器能够以批处理方式并行处理多个CVRP实例，我们利用它来求解由新到客户选择送货上门或自提方式所产生的候选路径问题。
tldr: 该论文提出了GREAT-ESDD框架，基于图边注意力网络开发了能够适应不同规模与变化条件、可对部分执行路线进行再优化的CVRP神经求解器，并据此构建了融合送货上门与户外自提选项的动态定价与路径规划框架，以低成本应对不断增长的在线当日达配送需求。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes GREAT-ESDD, a dynamic pricing-and-routing framework built on a Graph Edge Attention Network neural solver for CVRP that handles varying instance sizes and reoptimizes partially executed routes under changing conditions, enabling cost-effective same-day delivery decisions that combine home and out-of-home delivery options.
